DiscoveryEvidenceMetrics.title: DiscoveryEvidenceMetrics
DiscoveryEvidenceMetrics.description:
What the structured evidence index holds for this run, per kind.

These are the deterministic counts from the evidence analysis, not a second counting pass: the
canvas reads the same numbers the evidence API reports.

DiscoveryEvidenceRef.title: DiscoveryEvidenceRef
DiscoveryEvidenceRef.description:
One captured exploration artefact, addressed per discovery node.

``id`` is stable across polls so a later round can attach more collections to the
same node without renumbering anything.

DiscoveryIntelligenceMetrics.title: DiscoveryIntelligenceMetrics
DiscoveryIntelligenceMetrics.description:
What the model-assisted reading layer holds, counted once from the stored readings.

``jev_graded`` counts readings Jev actually scored; a fallback is counted separately so no
consumer can mistake it for a Jev success.

DiscoveryIntelligenceRequest.description: A request to read the unsettled scenarios; the bound task owns the work.

DiscoveryMetrics.description: Counts a discovery run already knows; the canvas shows them instead of guessing.

QAProjectContract.title: QAProjectContract
QAProjectContract.description:
Everything the platform needs to install, collect and run one QA project.

The contract is either read from `.qa-platform.yaml` in the project or produced by
:class:`qa_core.onboarding.detector.QAProjectDetector`. Detection never writes to the project:
a suggested contract is previewed to the operator first.

QAProjectDetection.title: QAProjectDetection
QAProjectDetection.description: Outcome of inspecting a project root.

QAProjectFramework.title: QAProjectFramework
QAProjectFramework.description: Test framework a QA project is written against.

QARuntimeProfile.title: QARuntimeProfile
QARuntimeProfile.description:
Isolated execution runtime for a QA project.

A QA repository must never execute inside the platform API's own interpreter: it can require a
different Python version and its own dependency set.

WorkflowEvidenceRef.title: WorkflowEvidenceRef
WorkflowEvidenceRef.description: One addressable artefact behind a node: an artifact id, a file path or an API path.
